selection.agreement_basis: Existing policy: settled CL and total CD agree with at least two genuinely finer comparable meshes. Recompute identical last 0.2 s means from raw data, with hydrodynamic CL. Retain the adjacent-window stability checks and examine force components.

stabilization.component_diagnostics: Pressure and viscous deltas relative to total CD and possible cancellation; no own-component 0.5%-gate.

selection.CL_convention: CL_total - buoyancy/(0.5*rho*U^2*S); unchanged baseline: 22.718189111947265/3855.6. Validate geometry, span, rho, U and area before reusing offset.
selection.comparability: Same foil, angle, domain, waterline, single spanwise cell, physics, boundary conditions, time order, dt and inner-iteration treatment. More cells alone do not prove finer resolution.
selection.no_claims: Optimization candidates are not automatically a systematic GCI family or wave validation. Keep original M10/M11/M12 GCI evidence intact.

user_primary_CL_CD_override.save_policy: Only verified gentle saved stop; never falsely mark legacy solver stabilized.

lightweight_optimization_screen.reference_basis: Recompute means over a matched physical-time window for each run from raw data; compare against original M12 accepted reference, with explicit dt sensitivity assessment
lightweight_optimization_screen.separate_temporal_settling_gate: CL and total CD each mean drift and RMS <0.5% over adjacent full 0.2s windows, 2 consecutive checks
numerical_guards: valid prism coverage and cell quality
lightweight_optimization_screen.existing_stricter_1pct_reference_retaine: Original 1% GCI-oriented mesh agreement remains recorded for rigor; it is NOT a hard screen for this new 5% practical optimization objective.
lightweight_optimization_screen.explanatory_note: M10/M11/M12 have unequal dt, so their currently displayed CL/CD deviations are provisional for a strict mesh-only verdict.

watch_policy.idle_after_verified_completion: Follow the separately copied and validated optimization workflow only when acceptance gates and resources permit. Journal attempts and verify that the next authorized job actually advances.

finish_objective: Once a sufficiently light and credible calm-water mesh is available, prioritize first defensible waves and varied H/lambda. Do not delay for full wave-specific grid convergence; user accepts this limited-resolution approximation. Never manufacture proof of wave accuracy.

wave_handoff.goal: Find a light, credible calm-water mesh and proceed to several physically interpretable wave cases. User explicitly accepts lack of formal wave-mesh independence as a compute-budget limitation; keep cheap wave-plausibility checks and disclose uncertainty.
wave_handoff.prepare_when_ready: Mandatory two stages per wave: verified flat calm-water continuation on same mesh/domain, then wave injected at upstream x_min or strictly localized inlet forcing from calm checkpoint; preserve initial flat downstream VOF and permit wave travel before evaluating forces. Record wave onset, arrival and averaging time; do not initialize a full wave field throughout domain.
wave_handoff.launch_policy: No automatic release of existing C01/wave hold. Once approved, proceed with selected calm-mesh-based wave setup without demanding costly formal wave-GCI; require only necessary basic propagation/numerical sanity checks before interpreting wave forces. Document unquantified wave-grid uncertainty.

phase_1_calm.wave_initial_condition: flat water at z=2 m in baseline domain
phase_1_calm.goal: Obtain and save a verified calm-water velocity, pressure, turbulence and VOF field for the same domain and foil arrangement. For propagation-only calibration the no-foil domain also starts flat and steady.
checks: Control of conservation/mass and physically plausible forces

phase_2_inlet_wave.start_from: verified phase-1 calm-water .sim without reinitializing/recreating the previous flow
phase_2_inlet_wave.wave_origin: upstream domain inlet x_min, or the narrow upstream wave forcing region if used as the physically equivalent boundary generator
phase_2_inlet_wave.initial_free_surface: preserve initially FLAT free surface downstream; do not prepopulate wave train in entire domain
phase_2_inlet_wave.generator: Configure selected wave model (existing FifthOrderVofWave), height and length, verified upstream orientation and phase; ramp/inlet transition if necessary for stability, counting it as startup transient
phase_2_inlet_wave.propagation: Allow wave to develop through upstream section, verify height/period/arrival and reflections at gauges; protect foil zone and damp outgoing waves downstream
phase_2_inlet_wave.discard: Discard initial boundary switching and wave-travel transient; begin force-period statistics only after arrival and sufficiently periodic response

results.time_indexing: Preserve calm saved timestamp and physical time; distinguish wave onset timestamp, first arrival at foil, and first accepted averaging window
results.comparison: Calculate wave-induced forces relative to same-setup calm control with matching density/area/CL convention and stable comparison windows; do not mix unequal startup histories
results.review_gates: No full wave GCI required under current compute-budget policy, but require basic propagation, CFL/VOF, reflections, mass-budget and time-window sanity checks before interpretation

controls.independent_surface_mesh_trials: Allowed geometrical preparation in separate E: root only if cheap and non-interfering. Propagation solver trials only after safe resource and hold authorization checks; not concurrent with current M12/M11/M10.

timestep_priority.user_priority: Aim for dt=0.001 s in practical W01/W02 and other foil-in-wave runs; dt=0.0001 s M12 is a conservative calm-water mesh-screen setting and must not become a default production wave timestep.
timestep_priority.selection_rule: Choose the least expensive (mesh,dt,VOF substepping,inner convergence) combination with stable finite free-surface transport and sufficiently insensitive wave probes/force results. Neither grid size nor the earlier calm-water dt alone proves a viable 1 ms foil simulation.
test_sequence: Use a common 1 ms physical step, same time order, 10 inner iterations and identical inlet/initial forcing, boundary/sponge conditions and probes across wave-only surface-mesh candidates. BEGIN with stabilized calm water, THEN inject wave upstream and allow propagation; never start with a domain filled by a wave.

Repeat a short matched segment at 0.5 ms on a chosen candidate, using identical physical windows and compare gauge amplitude, phase, reflection, and where available force response. Probe half-step only if its cost is justified and bounded.

If 1 ms triggers a guard, identify the local cause: advection/interface CFL, local foil cell size, pressure/VOF solver convergence, backflow near outlet or numerical startup. Do not assume refinement fixes a CFL failure; it can worsen time-step constraints.

When preparing joined foil+wave mesh, preserve supported near-foil/prism and wave surface resolutions, check transition and validity, then perform short calm-to-wave pilot at 1 ms with full guards. If 1 ms cannot pass, prefer an evidence-supported 0.5 ms rather than relaxing safety or corrupting scientific agreement.
0.1 ms is optional targeted diagnostic or independently supported fallback, not the default for all long waves.

prior_evidence.historic_W01_problem: Earlier foil-wave continuation at dt=1 ms had interface CFL around 4.58 and later numerical air jet; no-foil 1 ms run encountered outlet backflow and 50 m/s guard at t=0.704 s. Neither is evidence that simply refining a surface mesh makes 1 ms stable.

timestep_priority.research_limitations: 1 ms temporal accuracy and robust VOF/force convergence remain hypotheses to test; do not claim validated until short matched check passes.
timestep_priority.resource_safety: M12 is actively using GPU. Only offline mesh geometry/audit on spare CPU resources is permitted without altering its performance; do not launch another STAR solver or wave cases while the main solver holds resources or the C01 wave hold remains.

dashboard_forecast.methods: Anchored linear trend plus exponential/window-sensitivity scenarios; no calibrated confidence interval.

mission.ultimate_scientific_goal: Run trustworthy hydrofoil simulations in multiple incident wave conditions, quantify wave-induced CL/CD and negative wave added resistance, then investigate active feedforward flap control.
mission.mesh_goal: Select the lightest mesh that passes quality, force settling and comparable mesh-agreement checks and is usable as a starting point for wave-domain validation. Mesh is a means, not the deliverable.
mission.decision_principle: Prefer sufficient scientific validity and compute efficiency over marginal cell-count savings. Stop optional mesh coarsening as soon as a defensible lightweight candidate exists and further saving is small or risks delaying wave research.
do_not_relax: 1% CL/CD agreement with two genuinely finer comparable meshes
documented mesh quality and source provenance
stage_priority: Complete or transparently diagnose baseline calm-water mesh verification M12/M11/M10; do not fabricate confirmations
Choose lowest-cost supported production candidate, possibly with no extra mesh variant if evidence is already sufficient
Preserve a usable settled calm-water checkpoint and document wave-domain changes and validation blockers

After explicit review of C01/wave hold, start from accepted flat calm water on the selected wave-domain mesh, inject each wave at upstream inlet and propagate it to the foil before sampling forces; then run W01/W02
Continue authorized contrasting wave-height/wavelength cases from original wave extension plan, analyze wave-added forces
Once wave baseline is trustworthy, assess active flap control as a separate controlled comparison
mission.critical_transition: Use practical wave production target dt=0.001 s (if verified), compare to 0.0005 s on bounded cases; do not automatically use 0.0001 s M12 step for all waves. Short no-foil wave-surface trials then join with credible foil nearfield and start waves from calm checkpoint/inlet.

wave_mesh_accuracy_budget.user_decision: Explicitly accept not having a formally mesh-verified wave solution because of limited computing power; prioritize wave simulations once a defendable lightweight calm-water reference is chosen.
wave_mesh_accuracy_budget.status_for_wave_mesh: Transferred from calm-water-supported mesh. Wave-specific grid convergence/uncertainty is NOT established.
wave_mesh_accuracy_budget.cost_strategy: Reuse chosen calm-water-verified hydrofoil mesh as the starting template. Make only essential local wave/surface/domain adjustments as physics and stability demand, avoiding a new 3-mesh wave GCI campaign.
minimal_wave_case_sanity_checks: Check incident wave height, length/period, direction and arrival at the foil against imposed conditions at available probes/field views.
Check finite stable VOF, interface/flow CFL, mass conservation, and absence of severe unexplained numerical force spikes or unphysical wave reflections.

Check that at least the foil and dynamically important free-surface band have plausible spatial resolution for the chosen wavelength/height, and respond to obvious under-resolution without a full convergence campaign.
Compare wave-added loads only after initial transients, using consistent cycle windows and the same solver configuration across cases.
wave_mesh_accuracy_budget.important_distinction: Short plausibility/quality checks prevent invalid calculations; they are NOT formal wave mesh validation or proof of grid independence.
wave_mesh_accuracy_budget.research_claims: Report results as exploratory, subject to unquantified wave-discretization uncertainty. Separate observations and within-mesh trends from validated absolute negative wave added resistance. Avoid strong quantitative accuracy claims absent further evidence.
wave_mesh_accuracy_budget.stop_rule: Do not hold up wave research awaiting full wave-GCI. If simple checks reveal manifestly wrong propagation or unstable numerics, fix the concrete cause or clearly flag limitations instead of silently accepting invalid data.
wave_mesh_accuracy_budget.preserve_calm_gates: Existing 0.5% calm force stabilization and 1% comparable CL/CD mesh-agreement gates remain unchanged. An early switch cannot misrepresent failed calm checks as passing.
wave_mesh_accuracy_budget.wave_hold: Still respect existing user hold/ready review for C01 and waves. Policy does not itself authorize releasing that hold or auto-starting waves.

parallel_execution.authorization: User explicitly allows parallel mesh calculations if they do not drastically increase M12 time per step.
parallel_execution.first_auxiliary_backend: CPU only, 2 workers, BELOW_NORMAL priority; never a second GPU solve
parallel_execution.comparison: Measure before/after in same M12 continuation using wall_seconds increments. Baseline median of >=200 consecutive physical steps; use two independent windows of >=30 newly completed M12 steps and assess persistent slowdown. Log full wall-time and save overhead separately.
parallel_execution.automatic_action_on_slowdown: Graceful STOP for AUXILIARY only; no M12 stop, no M12 affinity/priority/configuration changes. Also stop auxiliary on stale M12 history, primary stage change, insufficient RAM/disk or explicit pause.
parallel_execution.first_pilot: Isolated M10 calm-water performance test on copied verified pilot final.sim, same dt=0.0001 and 10 inner iterations; no acceptance claim and no modification to existing GPU queue.
parallel_execution.later_scope: One independently configured no-foil wave-surface trial on CPU at target dt=0.001 may run after resource pilot passes and upstream calm-first setup is verified. Preserve existing held C01/foil-wave and HF; new no-foil test is separate authorized scope, not a release of their hold.
